option_relations.rationale: Fibrosis and ulceration caused by meperidine is a broader category that encompasses injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury, as meperidine is an injectable drug and the option describes skin and soft tissue injury.
Post-injection granuloma is a type of injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury, making it a supertype of the more specific leaf.
Factitial panniculitis is a broader category that can include injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury, especially when the injections are self-administered and lead to panniculitis.

Meperidine-induced panniculitis is a specific instance of injectable drug-induced skin and soft tissue injury, where meperidine is the injectable drug causing the panniculitis, making it equivalent to the leaf.
